text: The service is excellent, especially the doctor and staff at this clinic. You don't have to be intimidated; they're very polite. Almost every household in my village goes there. We recommend it to each other; whenever someone has a problem, we tell them, "Go to this clinic, it's really good!"
Good service, parking available, and helpful advice given.
Why didn't you take me the good way, you idiot?
The doctor is good and the price is affordable.
